title: Nauuo and Votes
statementMd:
Nauuo is a girl who loves writing comments.

One day, she posted a comment on Codeforces, wondering whether she would get upvotes or downvotes.

It's known that there were $x$ persons who would upvote, $y$ persons who would downvote, and there were also another $z$ persons who would vote, but you don't know whether they would upvote or downvote. Note that each of the $x+y+z$ people would vote exactly one time.

There are three different results: if there are more people upvote than downvote, the result will be "+"; if there are more people downvote than upvote, the result will be "-"; otherwise the result will be "0".

Because of the $z$ unknown persons, the result may be uncertain (i.e. there are more than one possible results). More formally, the result is uncertain if and only if there exist two different situations of how the $z$ persons vote, that the results are different in the two situations.

Tell Nauuo the result or report that the result is uncertain.

## Input

The only line contains three integers $x$, $y$, $z$ ($0\le x,y,z\le100$), corresponding to the number of persons who would upvote, downvote or unknown.

## Output

If there is **only one** possible result, print the result : "+", "-" or "0".

Otherwise, print "?" to report that the result is uncertain.

## Note

In the first example, Nauuo would definitely get three upvotes and seven downvotes, so the only possible result is "-".

In the second example, no matter the person unknown downvotes or upvotes, Nauuo would get more upvotes than downvotes. So the only possible result is "+".

In the third example, Nauuo would definitely get one upvote and one downvote, so the only possible result is "0".

In the fourth example, if the only one person upvoted, the result would be "+", otherwise, the result would be "-". There are two possible results, so the result is uncertain.
statementZhMd:
Nauuo 是一个喜欢发表评论的女孩。

一天，她在 Codeforces 上发表了一条评论，想知道自己会得到赞成票还是反对票。

已知有 $x$ 个人会投赞成票，$y$ 个人会投反对票，另外还有 $z$ 个人会投票，但你不知道他们会投赞成票还是反对票。注意，这 $x+y+z$ 个人中的每个人都会恰好投票一次。

结果有三种：如果投赞成票的人数多于投反对票的人数，结果为 "+"；如果投反对票的人数多于投赞成票的人数，结果为 "-"；否则结果为 "0"。

由于有 $z$ 个未知人员，结果可能是不确定的（即存在多个可能的结果）。更正式地说，当且仅当存在两种关于这 $z$ 个人如何投票的不同情况，使得两种情况下的结果不同，结果才是不确定的。

告诉 Nauuo 结果，或报告结果不确定。

## 输入格式

唯一一行包含三个整数 $x$、$y$、$z$（$0\le x,y,z\le100$），分别表示会投赞成票、反对票或未知的人员数量。

## 输出格式

如果只有一种可能的结果，输出该结果："+"、"-" 或 "0"。

否则，输出 "?"，表示结果不确定。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Nauuo 一定会得到三张赞成票和七张反对票，因此唯一可能的结果是 "-"。

在第二个样例中，无论未知人员投反对票还是赞成票，Nauuo 得到的赞成票数都会多于反对票数。因此唯一可能的结果是 "+"。

在第三个样例中，Nauuo 一定会得到一张赞成票和一张反对票，因此唯一可能的结果是 "0"。

在第四个样例中，如果唯一的那个人投赞成票，结果将是 "+"；否则结果将是 "-"。存在两种可能的结果，因此结果是不确定的。
